subject_mentions.description: Exact names or codes copied verbatim from the current user message. Empty if using context or if no subject is provided.

subject_source.description: Use context only when reusing an object the user refers to in the same conversation.

trading_days.description: Trailing trading days requested by the user. Zero if unspecified. Use -1 if the explicit range is in calendar dates or unsupported units.

advice.description: Set declined if this tool fulfils just the historical part of a mixed research and investment advice request.
